description: This file defines the RAGQuery class with static methods for processing messages, building context, adding search results, and extracting documents in a retrieval-augmented generation system.

classes.name: RAGQuery
classes.description: A class providing static methods for handling retrieval-augmented generation query processing, including message extraction, context building, and search result integration.

methods.name: extract_query_from_messages
methods.description: Extracts a query string from the last user message in a list of messages.

methods.name: build_context_message
methods.description: Builds a context message from search result chunks for use in a chat.

methods.name: add_search_results_to_response
methods.description: Inserts search and rerank results into a ModelResponse's choices.

methods.name: extract_documents_from_search
methods.description: Extracts text documents from a vector store search response.

methods.name: get_top_chunks_from_rerank
methods.description: Retrieves original search results corresponding to top reranked results.
